en: The postcard features a colored photograph of a large neo-Gothic church with prominent spires and a clock tower, situated in a landscaped urban area. The text 'Sundsvall. Kyrkan.' is printed at the top, indicating the location and subject—'Kyrkan' means 'The Church' in Swedish. The reverse side has handwriting in Swedish, an old Swedish stamp, and a postmark dated 1907, addressed to a recipient in Sweden.
